description: This file contains the implementation of the StreamPubSubImpl class, which manages publish-subscribe interactions for streaming data within the Orleans framework. It handles registration, unregistration, subscription management, and fault handling for stream producers and consumers, utilizing both explicit and implicit pub/sub mechanisms.

classes.name: StreamPubSubImpl
classes.description: Implements the IStreamPubSub interface, managing pub/sub operations for streams, including registration, unregistration, subscription retrieval, and fault handling, coordinating between explicit and implicit pub/sub mechanisms.

methods.name: StreamPubSubImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pub/sub implementation with explicit and implicit pub/sub instances.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream, combining results from explicit and implicit pub/sub mechanisms.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specific stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer for a stream, choosing between implicit and explicit mechanisms based on the consumer.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a stream, determining the mechanism based on the consumer.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a given stream.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a given stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, optionally filtered by a specific consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription ID for a consumer on a stream.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Marks a subscription as faulty, based on stream and subscription ID.
